title.en: Cell-current Picard relaxation and Green feedback
title.zh: 单元电流 Picard 松弛与 Green 反馈

summary: Mask a toroidal current-density grid, convert it to cell currents, relax those currents against the previous state and project flux and optional field responses through dense Green matrices.

capability: Cell-current Picard relaxation with Green feedback
Mask a toroidal current-density grid, relax cell currents and project flux and field responses through caller-supplied dense Green matrices.
operation: one explicit cell-current Picard feedback step using caller-provided dense linear Green responses
j_phi, grid, mask, prior current state, relax and Green matrices -> relaxed flux, field and current state
discovery.model: One explicit cell-current Picard feedback step with caller-provided dense linear Green responses.
discovery.geometry: Strictly monotone rectilinear R-Z tensor grid with at least two nodes per axis; fields indexed [Z,R] with C-order Green row and column flattening.
discovery.boundary: No wall or free-boundary condition is solved; supplied vacuum fields are the additive reference state.

identity.relation: toroidal current density and prior cell-current state to relaxed Green-response flux and poloidal field
identity.direction: j_phi, R-Z grid, mask, old currents, relaxation, Green matrices and vacuum state -> new psi, BR, BZ and current state
identity.definition: Default composite-trapezoid weights integrate exactly over the supplied node-domain rectangle; boundary nodes have half-interval weights. Explicit cell_edges=(radial_edges,axial_edges), each with center_count+1 monotone finite entries enclosing its centers, instead define cell-center areas. No 2*pi*R factor multiplies toroidal filament current. Set inactive density to zero; I=(1-relax)*I_raw+relax*I_old. Project psi through G_psi. A paired G_BR/G_BZ supplies field responses; when absent, differentiate the same added flux and add that magnetic increment to the vacuum field.
identity.model: one explicit cell-current Picard feedback step using caller-provided dense linear Green responses
identity.geometry: Strictly monotone rectilinear R-Z tensor grid, ascending or descending, uniform or nonuniform, at least two nodes per axis.
identity.coordinates: all fields indexed [Z,R], and Green rows/columns use C-order flattened grid points and source cells
identity.boundary: No wall or free-boundary condition is solved here; supplied vacuum fields are the additive reference state.
assumptions: The caller's Green matrices match the declared cell-current ordering and SI response units.
relax weights the previous cell-current state, not the previous flux.

inputs.name: j_phi
inputs.description: Toroidal current density before optional plasma clipping.
inputs.constraints: Same shape as the grid; inactive cells become zero when a mask is supplied.

inputs.name: r_grid
inputs.constraints: At least two points per axis, rows repeat one strictly monotone radial axis within the implementation tolerances; descending axes are allowed.

inputs.name: z_grid
inputs.constraints: Same grid shape; columns repeat one strictly monotone axial axis within the implementation tolerances; descending axes are allowed.

inputs.name: plasma_mask
inputs.description: Optional active-cell selector, passed explicitly as None when absent.
inputs.constraints: None means all cells active; otherwise exact grid shape and boolean dtype, without broadcast or 0/1 coercion.

inputs.name: currents_old
inputs.description: Previous relaxed cell-current state, passed explicitly as None for zero initialization.
inputs.constraints: None initializes all zeros; otherwise exact flattened length and finite values.

inputs.name: relax
inputs.description: Retention weight of the old cell-current state.
inputs.constraints: 0 <= relax <= 1; 0 uses raw current, 1 retains the old state.

inputs.name: g_psi
inputs.description: Dense current-to-flux Green response for psi=R A_phi.
inputs.constraints: Required, exact square shape; rows are field points and columns are C-order source cells.

inputs.name: g_br
inputs.description: Optional current-to-radial-field Green response, passed explicitly as None when absent.
inputs.constraints: Must be supplied as a finite exact square matrix together with g_bz, or both must be None.

inputs.name: g_bz
inputs.description: Optional current-to-axial-field Green response, passed explicitly as None when absent.
inputs.constraints: Must be supplied as a finite exact square matrix together with g_br, or both must be None.

inputs.name: psi_vac
inputs.description: Vacuum or external psi=R A_phi offset.
inputs.constraints: Exact grid shape; added to the g_psi response.

inputs.name: br_vac
inputs.constraints: Exact grid shape; when field Green matrices are absent, add the discrete field increment derived from the same plasma flux increment.

inputs.name: bz_vac
inputs.constraints: Exact grid shape; when field Green matrices are absent, add the discrete field increment derived from the same plasma flux increment.

inputs.name: cell_edges
inputs.description: Default composite-trapezoid weights integrate exactly over the supplied node-domain rectangle; boundary nodes have half-interval weights. Explicit cell_edges=(radial_edges,axial_edges), each with center_count+1 monotone finite entries enclosing its centers, instead define cell-center areas. No 2*pi*R factor multiplies toroidal filament current.
inputs.dtype: pair of finite arrays or None
inputs.constraints: Default composite-trapezoid weights integrate exactly over the supplied node-domain rectangle; boundary nodes have half-interval weights. Explicit cell_edges=(radial_edges,axial_edges), each with center_count+1 monotone finite entries enclosing its centers, instead define cell-center areas. No 2*pi*R factor multiplies toroidal filament current.

outputs.name: psi
outputs.description: Vacuum psi=R A_phi plus relaxed-current Green response.
outputs.constraints: The matrix response uses C-order flattened cell currents.

outputs.name: BR
outputs.description: Vacuum radial field plus the same added plasma-flux field response.
outputs.constraints: With paired field Green matrices, add g_br times the relaxed source currents; when both are None, add -dZ(psi-psi_vac)/R using the maintained discrete flux derivative and regular-axis rule.

outputs.name: BZ
outputs.description: Vacuum axial field plus the same added plasma-flux field response.
outputs.constraints: With paired field Green matrices, add g_bz times the relaxed source currents; when both are None, add dR(psi-psi_vac)/R using the maintained discrete flux derivative and regular-axis rule.

outputs.name: j_phi
outputs.constraints: Zero outside True cells when a mask is supplied.

outputs.name: initial_picard_current_state
outputs.description: Zero current vector for graph zero-step initialization.
outputs.constraints: Always zeros, independent of supplied currents_old.

outputs.name: picard_current_state
outputs.description: Relaxed C-order flattened cell-current vector used by the Green projections.

outputs.name: plasma_currents
outputs.description: Terminal or step current density integrated with the explicitly declared node/cell-domain weights.
outputs.constraints: Default composite-trapezoid weights integrate exactly over the supplied node-domain rectangle; boundary nodes have half-interval weights. Explicit cell_edges=(radial_edges,axial_edges), each with center_count+1 monotone finite entries enclosing its centers, instead define cell-center areas. No 2*pi*R factor multiplies toroidal filament current.

preconditions: Default composite-trapezoid weights integrate exactly over the supplied node-domain rectangle; boundary nodes have half-interval weights. Explicit cell_edges=(radial_edges,axial_edges), each with center_count+1 monotone finite entries enclosing its centers, instead define cell-center areas. No 2*pi*R factor multiplies toroidal filament current.
Supplied vacuum psi and magnetic components describe the same physical state; all Green matrices use the same current basis and flux convention.
supported: One masked current-relaxation step on declared quadrature geometry, including a derived magnetic response when field Green matrices are absent.
excluded: Automatic construction or physical validation of a Green response; complete equilibrium or wall solution.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Reject malformed arrays, non-tensor/nonmonotone grids, negative radius, fewer than two locations per axis, invalid cell edges, bad mask/state/relaxation, or unpaired field Green matrices.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: NumPy matrix-arithmetic failures propagate; finite inputs that overflow a matrix product are not postvalidated for finite outputs.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; this Operator performs exactly one feedback step and no convergence check.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial dictionary is returned after input or matrix-operation failure.

python.signature: update_anisotropic_picard_flux(j_phi, r_grid, z_grid, plasma_mask, currents_old, relax, g_psi, g_br, g_bz, psi_vac, br_vac, bz_vac, *, cell_edges=None)

example.description: Explicit two-by-two cell boundaries distinguish raw and relaxed currents and test all three Green projections.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.equilibrium import update_anisotropic_picard_flux
r, z = np.meshgrid([0.2, 0.4], [-0.1, 0.1])
j = np.array([[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]])
mask = np.array([[True, False], [False, True]])
old = np.array([0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5])
result = update_anisotropic_picard_flux(j, r, z, mask, old, 0.25, np.eye(4), 2*np.eye(4), -np.eye(4), np.zeros((2,2)), np.ones((2,2)), 2*np.ones((2,2)), cell_edges=([.1,.3,.5],[-.2,0.,.2]))
raw = np.array([0.04, 0.0, 0.0, 0.16])
relaxed = 0.75*raw + 0.25*old
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['plasma_currents'].ravel(), raw)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['picard_current_state'], relaxed)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['psi'].ravel(), relaxed)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['BR'].ravel(), 1.0 + 2*relaxed)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['BZ'].ravel(), 2.0 - relaxed)
example.expected: Only two cells carry raw current, and flux/field outputs use the relaxed current vector.

scope: Explicit-cell uniform behavior; node-domain nonuniform current quadrature; two-node and descending-axis support.
Missing field Green pair produces the magnetic derivative of the added plasma flux, preserving the vacuum reference.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Manufactured and analytic discrete checks establish only the stated poloidal model and declared integration geometry. Arbitrary Green matrices, pressure closures, experimental plasma applicability and public release are not established by these tests.
known_limitations: Caller-supplied physical closures and Green responses require their own evidence and coherent psi=R A_phi (Wb/rad) normalization.
Floating-point rounding envelopes do not bound discretization error or experimental uncertainty.
No expert scientific endorsement or public release follows from this numerical successor.
